entities.summary: Cordelia Fine is a Canadian-born British philosopher of science, psychologist, writer, and science communicator, who lives in Australia. As of 2018 she is a full professor in the History and Philosophy of Science programme at the University of Melbourne, Australia. Fine has written several popular science books on the topics of social cognition, neuroscience, and the popular myths of sex differences. She is especially known for Testosterone Rex, which won the Royal Society Science Book Prize in 2017.
